rationale: The exchange has produced procedural agreement on site-by-site analysis and an independent expert, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour/state insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/owners/investors still insist those tools remain available if the numbers require them. Positions have hardened over the last two rounds, with repetition rather than substantive movement, so further rounds are unlikely to change the underlying impasse without a formal intervention.
